Restrained antique-gold rune shield emblem with dark indigo paper-cut outline, centered and readable at small size, actual transparent background, no frame or text.

componentRules.progressBar: Use UIProgressBar with RectMask2D. Use img_progressTrack on the container and img_progressFill as a child fill image; authoring groupPath is descriptive only and does not wire this hierarchy.
componentRules.spellBoard: Create exactly 24 reusable spell card instances in a 6-column by 4-row grid.
componentRules.equipmentBar: Create exactly four equipment spell card instances in one row. The equipment panel must not contain baked slot wells; every card reuses tile_spellSlotBase.
componentRules.spellSlotStates: The common root uses tile_spellSlotBase. EmptyRoot contains only img_spellSlotEmptyMark. FilledRoot contains only the runtime spell icon and dynamic tier/level content. EmptyRoot and FilledRoot are mutually exclusive through UIItemSlot.
componentRules.spellSlotOverlays: img_spellSelectedOverlay is a selected-state-only corner accent above the slot. icon_spellLocked is a locked-state-only badge. Do not stack another complete frame over tile_spellSlotBase.
componentRules.layerOrder: Keep the imported Unity hierarchy flat. com.july.ui.authoring sorts order descending before creation, so larger values are farther back and smaller values render in front.
componentRules.dynamicText: All stage, currency, pending count, generation, health, shield, tier, level, result, and cooldown values remain Unity-rendered text and are never baked into bitmaps.
